technical.summary: MCD shows short-term overbought conditions with strong volume spike and force index confirmation, but lacks intermediate trend support and faces bearish cloud positioning with negative accumulation signals—high pullback risk outweighs bullish momentum.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional accumulation, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (recent small purchases offset by larger May sale) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis level 335.68, rising USD, imminent CPI event) creates severe headwinds for discretionary consumer stocks; earnings binary in 14 days compounds risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (20/100) with contrarian buy signal and volume spike (15x) plus force index confirmation offer tactical short-term bounce opportunity from support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (78.78) combined with macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 335.68), imminent earnings binary, weak intermediate trend (below 50-SMA/EMA), negative accumulation (CMF false), and bearish cloud positioning create severe pullback and event risk that overwhelms momentum signals.
debate.price_positioning: near_support — but support unreliable given macro headwinds and earnings event risk

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment (20/100) and 15x volume spike offer contrarian bounce potential from support; however, overbought RSI (78.78) and bearish cloud positioning create immediate pullback risk that negates entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary in 14 days combined with macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 335.68) and weak intermediate trend (below 50-SMA/EMA) create severe event and drawdown risk for discretionary consumer stock.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought, fundamental weak, sentiment contrarian but unconfirmed, macro severely unfavourable
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MCD with 20 existing Consumer Discretionary positions (23% of portfolio); adding concentration risk in sector during macro crisis is imprudent despite existing position.
